summary: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 to require states with an improper payment rate exceeding 5 percent to submit a corrective action plan and face conditional ineligibility for funds if the rate remains above 5 percent for two consecutive years.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act to implement an improper payment threshold. By requiring states to reduce improper payments or face conditional ineligibility for funds, it aims to reduce waste in a program that is part of the social safety net, thus reducing welfare spending.
